author: Jerrryy
body:
Definately more than one year since ive been banned. 
Username?-J3rry_
Reason for ban- Autoclicker
Why should i be unbanned?- As u can see, I really really want to play on Avicus again with 'J3rry_' throughout this pass year and a half? I have always had Avicus on my minecraft multiplayer screen. Not sure why, every once in awhile i click on it just to see if by any chance ive been unbanned. But no. I practically gave up hope on Avicus. Until recently, my old clan mates 'The Game Changers' or the current 'Apollo' recreated a skype group and everyone was asking me to appeal again, and so... here i am :)). Im not holding much hope that this appeal goes through, as i have been caught for banevading, but hey, ill give it a shot, for my old friends, why not?
